skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — add background music and auto-sync cuts to the beat — and get music-synced...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of "AI Video Editing with Music — Edit Videos with Synced Music".
- Instantly sync video cuts to music beats and add background music with a simple prompt.
- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM files up to 500MB for fast, cloud-based rendering.
- No editing software or installation required; ideal for TikTok and short-form creators.
- Automatic setup and credits management; jobs are handled securely on remote GPU servers.
- Export edited videos in popular formats like MP4 with music synced in 30–60 seconds.
